facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 63°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 1 to 22 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Beaver Pass
evidence.detail: left May 14; earlier seasons: June 5 (2023), June 7 (2024), June 5 (2025)

evidence.name: Thunder Basin
evidence.detail: left May 7; earlier seasons: May 24 (2023), May 23 (2024), May 18 (2025)

evidence.name: Brown Top
evidence.detail: left June 16; earlier seasons: June 11 (2023), June 22 (2024), June 17 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Brown Top (5,850 ft), the third highest at Thunder Basin (4,310 ft) and the lowest at Beaver Pass (3,630 ft).

evidence.name: Beaver Pass
evidence.detail: 15.0 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 34.1 in (2023), 27.0 in (2024), 31.2 in (2025)

evidence.name: Thunder Basin
evidence.detail: 24.2 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 29.7 in (2023), 22.5 in (2024), 27.4 in (2025)

evidence.name: Brown Top
evidence.detail: 62.7 in on April 3; earlier seasons: 56.5 in (2023), 36.0 in (2024), 50.4 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 13 and May 17, carried from the melt-out dates at Beaver Pass (3,630 ft) and Thunder Basin (4,310 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Beaver Pass
evidence.detail: melted out May 14, 1,144 ft above the pass; points to March 25 to May 24

evidence.name: Thunder Basin
evidence.detail: melted out May 7, 1,824 ft above the pass; points to March 1 to May 10
